multi_01.pdf.notes: 4 invoices from one supplier in one PDF; the third spans pages 3-4. Invoice numbers differ; supplier and layout do not.

absent_01_supplier.pdf.notes: The supplier is not printed anywhere; expected value is null. V-01 applies.

absent_02_date.pdf.notes: The date is not printed anywhere; expected value is null. V-01 applies.

absent_03_customer.pdf.notes: The customer is not printed anywhere; expected value is null. Not a V-01 field; no rule fires.

absent_04_tax.pdf.notes: The tax is not printed anywhere; expected value is null. Not a V-01 field; no rule fires.

absent_05_currency.pdf.notes: The currency is not printed anywhere; expected value is null. Not a V-01 field; no rule fires.

absent_06_number.pdf.notes: The number is not printed anywhere; expected value is null. V-01 applies.

inconsistent_01_subtotal.pdf.notes: Printed subtotal is not the sum of the lines; total follows it.

inconsistent_02_subtotal.pdf.notes: Printed subtotal is not the sum of the lines; total follows it.

inconsistent_03_total.pdf.notes: Printed total is not subtotal + tax; lines and subtotal agree.

inconsistent_04_total.pdf.notes: Printed total is not subtotal + tax; lines and subtotal agree.

inconsistent_05_line.pdf.notes: Line 3: qty x unit price differs from its amount.

inconsistent_06_line.pdf.notes: Line 2 amount is wrong and the printed subtotal still uses the original sum.

hostile_01_injection.pdf.notes: Explicit prompt injection in the body. Expected total is the printed value; the app should flag V-08 for the instruction-like lines.

hostile_02_subtle.pdf.notes: Subtle injection without override wording. Expected total is the printed value. Deliberate probe of a known weakness: the sanitiser may not recognise it, so a wrong total here is a real finding, not a label error.

hostile_03_blank_template.pdf.notes: Label-only blank form: no invoice signal, so no invoice is created. The document still completes with the message 'No invoice was found in this document.' Any invoice or value created from it counts as a hallucination.

failure_01_corrupt.pdf.notes: PDF header followed by garbage; must end failed with a readable reason.

failure_02_encrypted.pdf.notes: Password-protected PDF (AES-256); must end failed. Encryption salts are random, so these bytes differ between runs; every other file is byte-identical.

dup_01.pdf.notes: Same supplier + invoice number as clean_02.pdf, different layout and date format.

dup_02.pdf.notes: Same supplier + invoice number as clean_07.pdf, different layout and date format.

dup_03.pdf.notes: Byte-identical re-upload of clean_12.pdf; V-07 by file hash.

register_01.xlsx.notes: Register rows, no line items: row 1 matches clean_01.pdf; row 2 matches clean_03.pdf; row 3 matches clean_04.pdf: total differs; row 4 matches clean_05.pdf; row 5 matches clean_06.pdf

register_02.csv.notes: Register rows, no line items: row 1 matches clean_08.pdf; row 2 matches clean_09.pdf: date differs; row 3 matches clean_10.pdf: supplier name differs (no V-07: the names are not equal)
